description: Agent Vendors: submit the quote in front of the agent: its id, the vendor, the item or service, the scope, the quantity, the unit price, the currency, the total, when it was issued and when it lapses, its text, read for wording that implies a fee such as plus applicable fees, taxes extra or shipping calculated at checkout and wording that leaves the price open such as starting at, subject to change or estimated, and each priced line with its id, label, kind (an item, a fee, tax, shipping, a discount, a deposit or other) and amount; and optionally the moment to read it at. The signed report gives the quote, every line, each part (item or service, quantity or scope, total price, currency, validity window, fees named) with its status, and counts the lines, the fee lines and the implied fees with the lines’ total beside the stated total, and names a quote too vague to accept: no item or scope, no price, fees implied by wording no line prices, a price left open, lines that do not add up to the total and a total that differs from the unit price times the quantity with nothing itemizing the difference; then no stated total, no currency, no quantity, no validity date, an expired quote and an unpriced line, with the fix for each. Amounts compare to the cent. This reads one quote before it is accepted: ranking two or more quotes for the same job is wever_quote-compare, comparing vendor proposals across price, term and service levels is wever_procurement-decision-brief, a proposed deal’s terms deliverable by deliverable are wever_negotiation-terms-check and conversion quotes are wever_exchange-quote-check. Verdict quote_vague, quote_partial, quote_missing or quote_complete. POST /api/vendor-quote-check. Reads only the recorded vendor material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write; no vendor is contacted, no quote is accepted, no order is placed and no spend is approved. Agent Vendors reads the seller on the other side of a spend before the agent commits: whether the vendor is who it claims to be, whether its quote and terms hold together, whether its price stays the same and what it costs to leave. It is not one service’s terms on their own (wever_service-terms-check reads one service’s terms by themselves; the vendor terms-match check reads a vendor’s terms against the specific quote or order in front of the agent, where a contradiction costs money), not pricing structure or fee evidence (wever_pricing-tier-check and wever_fee-evidence-check; the vendor price check reads whether the price this vendor quoted this buyer stays consistent across the quote, the listing and any invoice or prior charge), not single promise types (wever_warranty-check and wever_shipping-check; the vendor delivery and refund checks read the whole delivery promise and the whole remedy path for one vendor engagement), not listing accuracy (wever_catalog-listing-check reads whether a catalog listing is accurate; a directory or marketplace listing being present is not vendor verification, and no vendor check treats listing presence as identity evidence), not after the payment (wever_purchase-record-check and wever_double-charge-check run after a payment; the vendor checks run before the spend, while walking away is still free), not the buyer’s own permission (wever_spending-policy-check and wever_authority-scope-check read the buyer’s permission to spend; the vendor checks read the seller on the other side of the spend: permission is not diligence, and diligence is not permission), not a promise once made (the wever_commitment checks; a vendor engagement becomes a commitment only after the agent accepts it, and the vendor checks guard the moment before that) and not an objective (the wever_goal checks read the objective the work serves; a vendor check reads a counterparty, not an objective). Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-vendors-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-vendors/.
